map.依据材料厚度与焊接方法推荐焊接电流、电压、速度与热输入等工艺参数，给出工艺窗口与: Recommend welding current, voltage, speed, and heat input from material thickness and welding method, giving the process window and notes.
map.💡 热输入 = I × U / (v × 1000) kJ/mm；焊接电流与厚度: 💡 Heat input = I × U / (v × 1000) kJ/mm; welding current scales with thickness, voltage is set by arc length.
map.参数为推荐中值，实际需通过工艺评定调整: Parameters are recommended mid-values; actual values need adjustment via procedure qualification.
map.厚板多层焊时每层电流可适当降低: For thick plates with multi-layer welding, each layer's current may be lowered slightly.
map.热输入控制对焊缝质量至关重要，需结合材料要求: Heat-input control is vital to weld quality and must follow material requirements.
map.📚 深度解析：焊接工艺参数计算（电流/电压/热输入）: 📚 Deep Dive: Welding Process Parameters (current / voltage / heat input)
map.焊接工艺评定：输入板厚与 method，算焊接电流、电压与热输入: Welding procedure qualification: enter plate thickness and method to compute current, voltage, and heat input.
map.热输入控制：热输入影响熔深、变形与热影响区: Heat-input control: heat input affects penetration, distortion, and the heat-affected zone.
map.层数估算：厚板按每层约 4mm 定焊道数: Layer estimate: thick plates use about 4 mm per layer to set the bead count.
map.算法：电流 I = 板厚×方法系数（SMAW45/TIG60/MIG100）；电: Algorithm: current I = thickness × method factor (SMAW45/TIG60/MIG100); voltage is the method-range midpoint; weld speed is the range midpoint; heat input HJ = I×U/(speed×1000) (kJ/mm); bead count = ⌈thickness/4⌉.
map.例：板厚 6mm、手工电弧焊(SMAW) → 电流 270A、电压 22V、焊速: Example: thickness 6 mm, SMAW → current 270 A, voltage 22 V, speed 4 mm/s, heat input 1.49 kJ/mm (moderate), 2 beads. If 10 mm, MIG → current 1000 A, voltage 24 V, speed 5 mm/s, heat input 4.8 kJ/mm (high, control inter-pass temp).
map.依材料与厚度：低碳钢一般 0.5~2.5kJ/mm；过高热影响区大、易裂，过低未: Depends on material and thickness: mild steel generally 0.5~2.5 kJ/mm; too high enlarges the HAZ and cracks, too low lacks penetration, follow the procedure.
map.单道焊熔深有限（约 4mm），厚板须多道多层；实际还受坡口与摆宽影响。: Single-pass penetration is limited (~4 mm); thick plates need multi-pass layers; in practice it also depends on the groove and weave width.
